name: ThreadStartParams
reason: Diverges on field set, not on the wire shape of what is sent: the hand-written MarshalJSON owns serialisation and TestMarshalledParamsSendEveryField proves every settable field reaches the wire, so nothing is silently dropped. The sdk-only fields (dynamicTools, runtimeWorkspaceRoots) are real upstream fields the vendored aggregate omits -- confirmed against thread.rs -- and `metadata` is genuinely invented (upstream ThreadStartParams has no such field); nothing sets it. The remaining aggregate-only fields are `serviceName`, `sessionStartSource` and `threadSource` -- analytics/telemetry classification, not the model/sandbox override set (which the SDK now mirrors from ThreadResumeParams); they remain settable through the per-thread config overlay (WithThreadConfigOverride).

name: TurnStartParams
reason: Diverges on field set, not on the wire shape of what is sent. There is no hand-written marshaller any more: wireInput was removed when Input became []UserInput, so the struct encodes directly. The sdk-only fields (collaborationMode, multiAgentMode, permissions) are real upstream fields that the vendored aggregate omits -- confirmed against codex-rs/protocol/v2/turn.rs, so they are not invented. The aggregate-only fields (disabledPluginIds, parentTurnId, rootTurnId, toolOutput, turnTrigger, personality, serviceTierForTurn) are real capabilities the SDK does not expose yet.
